macros.name: note
macros.doc: \note[⟨alignment⟩]{⟨height⟩}{⟨text⟩} The optional alignment argument is one of b, c, or t. The ⟨height⟩ argument names the guide to align to; ⟨text⟩ is the content of the note.

macros.name: sourcedoc
macros.doc: Set the file name of the PDF file whose pages are to be included.

envs.name: leftnotes
envs.doc: In twocolumn mode, it will move the enclosed \note macros to the left page margin; with twocolumn=false it does nothing, that is, notes enclosed in leftnotes will also show up in the right margin.

envs.name: page
envs.doc: This environment loads the physical page hpage numberi from the source document and sets up the containers for the margin notes.

envs.name: rightnotes
envs.doc: A no-op; it only exists to avoid tripping up users who might surmise its existence from that of the leftnotes environment.
